description: The bar chart illustrates average performance aggregated across five datasets (as stated in the caption) under two context conditions and for three labeled methods shown in the legend. The horizontal axis contains two grouped categories labeled “With Context” (left group) and “Without Context” (right group), with three adjacent bars within each group corresponding to the three legend entries (Standard, CInGS (w/), and CInGS); the groups appear in left-to-right order as With Context then Without Context. The vertical axis is labeled “Average Performance” and uses a linear numeric scale ranging from 0 to about 65, with regularly spaced tick labels at 10-unit intervals (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60) and horizontal gridlines aligned to these ticks. In the “With Context” group, there are three blue bars: the leftmost bar is blue with a dotted/circled hatch pattern and reaches a value in the mid‑50s (approximately 56), the middle bar is solid blue at just under 60 (approximately 57–58), and the rightmost bar is solid blue and is the tallest in the chart at about 60. In the “Without Context” group, there are three purple bars: the leftmost purple bar is around the mid‑40s (approximately 46), the middle purple bar is slightly higher in the upper‑40s (approximately 47–48), and the rightmost purple bar is slightly lower than the others in that group at around 45. The bars are presented as side-by-side (grouped) rather than stacked, and the legend at the top indicates three method labels (Standard, CInGS (w/), CInGS) using three grayscale swatches, while the plotted bars themselves are differentiated by group color (blue vs purple) and a hatch pattern on the first bar; no explicit sorting (e.g., descending) or numeric annotations are shown.
